# Contributing

This is a two-member coursework repository. Before making assessment changes, read `README.md`, `.ai/AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md`, and `docs/assessment-requirements.md`.

- Check the official brief for the relevant requirement before implementing it.
- Coordinate ownership of shared files with the other member.
- Keep commits focused and describe the change in plain language.
- Update documentation when project behavior, setup, or decisions change.
- Do not commit datasets, checkpoints, logs, or other generated artifacts until the brief and team agree they belong in Git.
- Do not commit secrets or local environment settings.

These are recommended collaboration practices, not assessment requirements.
